question: LEGO Group is privately held. What did it publish for the first half of 2026 (January 1 - June 30, 2026) for revenue in Danish kroner, how did reported revenue growth compare with constant-currency growth and consumer sales growth, and what were operating profit and the implied operating margin?
grading: Key points (all required): (1) H1 2026 revenue DKK 41.9 billion, +21% reported (H1 2025 DKK 34.6 billion); (2) +26% in constant currency; (3) consumer sales +22%; (4) operating profit DKK 10.9 billion (+22%), so operating margin about 26.0% (10.9/41.9; accept 25.8%-26.2%); (5) states the figures are published by LEGO itself (private company), not SEC-filed. Optional: net profit DKK 8.6 billion (+32%); operating cash flow DKK 8.6 billion. Fail if +26% is presented as reported growth, if USD is used as the primary currency, or if full-year 2025 figures are used.
answer: H1 2026: revenue DKK 41.9 billion, +21% reported (+26% in constant currency); consumer sales +22%; operating profit DKK 10.9 billion (+22%; +29% constant currency), an operating margin of about 26.0%; net profit DKK 8.6 billion (+32%) [W14-E1, W14-E2]. These are LEGO's own published results for a private company, not SEC filings.

output.answer:
## The LEGO Group — H1 2026 Results (Jan 1 – June 30, 2026)

Although LEGO A/S is privately held (owned by the Kirkbi/Christiansen family holding company and the LEGO Foundation), it voluntarily publishes a half-year results release. Its H1 2026 report was issued on **Tuesday, 25 August 2026**, covering the six months ended 30 June 2026.

### Revenue
| Metric | H1 2026 | H1 2025 |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | **DKK 41.9 billion** (record) | DKK 34.6 billion |
| Reported growth | **+21%** | — |

### Growth comparison
- **Reported revenue growth: +21%**
- **Constant-currency revenue growth: +26%** — i.e., about 5 percentage points higher, meaning foreign-exchange translation was a meaningful *headwind* on the reported DKK figure rather than a boost.
- **Consumer sales growth: +22%** — consumer sales (sell-through to end consumers through LEGO's own stores/online) grew slightly faster than reported revenue (sell-in to retailers). LEGO outpaced the global toy market and gained share.

So the ranking was: constant-currency revenue (+26%) > consumer sales (+22%) > reported revenue (+21%).

### Operating profit and implied operating margin
- **Operating profit: DKK 10.9 billion**, up **+22%** reported (+**29%** in constant currency)
- **Implied operating margin: ~26.0%** (10.9 ÷ 41.9)
  - H1 2025 implied margin: ~25.7% (8.9 ÷ 34.6) — a modest ~30 bp improvement year over year.

### Other notable figures
- **Net profit: DKK 8.6 billion**, up **+32%** (from DKK 6.5 billion)
- **Cash flow from operating activities: DKK 8.6 billion**, up +47%
- **Free cash flow: DKK 2.1 billion** (vs. DKK 1.7 billion)
- Capital investment of DKK 4.6 billion (factories/facilities) plus DKK 1.9 billion to acquire 29 LEGO/LEGOLAND Discovery Centres from Merlin Entertainments
- 332 new sets launched; 1,106 branded stores worldwide; ~34,000 employees
- Management had guided to "single-digit revenue growth" for full-year 2026 in its 2025 annual report, so H1 materially exceeded that plan.

### Sources
- LEGO Group official release (25 Aug 2026): [Strong demand and brand relevance drive LEGO Group revenue up 21%, operating profit up 22% in H1 2026](https://www.lego.com/en-us/aboutus/news/2026/august/strong-demand-and-brand-relevance-drive-lego-group-revenue-up-21-operating-profit-up-22-in-h1-2026)
- CNBC: [Lego reports first-half 2026 record revenue](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/25/lego-first-half-2026-revenue.html)
- Brickset: [LEGO achieves record revenue and increased profit in 1H 2026](https://brickset.com/article/134199/lego-achieves-record-revenue-and-increased-profit-in-1h-2026)
- Blocks Magazine: [The LEGO Group sees record growth in first half of 2026](https://blocksmag.com/the-lego-group-sees-record-growth-in-first-half-of-2026)
- Yahoo Finance/Quartz: [Lego H1 2026 earnings: revenue hits record $6.5 billion](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/lego-h1-2026-earnings-revenue-115542722.html)

**Note:** The operating margin is *implied* (calculated as operating profit ÷ revenue), because LEGO's half-year press release reports absolute revenue and operating profit and their growth rates, but does not itself state an operating-margin percentage. Also note LEGO's fiscal year is the calendar year, so its "H1 2026" is exactly January 1 – June 30, 2026.
